snippet.title: Dune: Awakening — Chapter 2 Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Change is coming to Arrakis. We’re excited to announce that our Chapter 2 Free Update and The Lost Harvest DLC will release on September 10th!

UPDATE: We have moved the date forward to September 9!

Read more about what's coming in the Chapter 2 Update, The Lost Harvest DLC, and more in our blog: https://bit.ly/DLCChapter2Update

Learn more about the Free Trial running from Aug 20-24th: https://bit.ly/DuneAwakeningFreeTrial

#duneawakening #dune
